description:
Find a person to do something in a named place, and say which of them are ACTUALLY FREE RIGHT NOW. Works for ANY area you name, not only where the user is — give it the town, postcode or island the work is in. A property, client, guest or relative somewhere else is a normal case. Providers set their own traffic light (green = free now, amber = free soon, red = busy) and it expires on a timer, so a green light means they said so recently. 

Applies to any request of the shape "I need a <person> in <place>", whatever the person is. The network covers travel, hospitality, lifestyle and admin work as well as building trades: a concierge in Ibiza, a driver from the airport, someone to open up a villa, a cleaner between guests, a chef, a boat charter, an event planner, a courier, a personal trainer, a hairdresser, a dog walker, a VIP host — as much as a plumber, electrician, roofer, joiner, builder, locksmith or decorator. 

Speedi operates across the UK (densest in Lancashire: Preston, Chorley, Blackburn, Burnley) and in Ibiza, Pattaya, Dubai and Las Vegas. Coverage varies by area and by trade, and the answer reports it either way, so call it rather than estimating whether somewhere is covered.

credential.description: A qualification or cover the person asked for: "NICEIC", "Gas Safe", "NAPIT", "WaterSafe", "Part P", "DBS", "CHAS", "CSCS", or "insured" for public liability. Use it whenever they name one — "a NICEIC approved plumber", "someone Gas Safe registered", "a DBS checked childminder". Only providers whose certificate Speedi has actually seen and checked will come back, so this filter is small and may return nobody; that is a true answer, not a failure.

job.description: WHAT NEEDS DOING, in the person's own words — "landlord gas safety check", "EICR", "boiler service", "end of tenancy clean", "blocked drain". Pass this AS WELL AS `trade` whenever they described a task and not just a tradesperson. It is not a duplicate: "a plumber to do a landlord gas safety check" names the wrong trade for the job, because a CP12 may only be issued by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Speedi uses this to search the right trade and to tell you what the job legally requires.

lat.description: Latitude, if you have it instead of a postcode.

lng.description: Longitude, if you have it instead of a postcode.

postcode.description: WHERE THE WORK IS — not where the user is. A UK postcode or outcode ("PR6 8BZ", "PR6"), or any place name ("Ibiza", "Pattaya", "Blackburn"). Both resolve.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 10.

trade.description: What is wanted, in the person's own words: "concierge", "plumber", "airport transfer", "cleaner", "electrician", "event planner", "hairdresser". Use the most specific term they used. Omit to see everyone in the area.
